parts.label: (a)
parts.stem: Samples of $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ are reacted separately with an excess of aqueous sodium hydroxide or with an excess of aqueous ammonia.
parts.text: Give the following information about these reactions.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: reaction 1: $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ with an excess of aqueous of sodium hydroxide

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: reaction 2: $[\text{Cu}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{2+}$ with an excess of aqueous ammonia

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Copper(I) oxide is added to hot dilute sulfuric acid. A blue solution, **X**, and a red-brown solid, **Y**, form.

Suggest the identities of **X** and **Y**. Name the type of reaction.
